description: Automated searches (D-24). Every run logs the query text, time and result ids. v0.2 (D-43): the older-adult filter is removed. v0.3 (D-51): `psychos*` also matched 'psychosocial' and 'psychosomatic', and a bare `attachment` matched any attachment, so most PubMed results were off-topic; both are narrowed. v0.4 (D-53): two searches for theme family A1 (spiritual or messianic beliefs), which the corpus lacked; their terms come from the A1 definition in README.md and seed_vocabulary_v0.2.json, never from Psychosis-Bench. Example queries, provisional: tune them against what they return, never against Psychosis-Bench.
